say:0:1721943001:1.text: Later, you see Aiden again. This time, he's playing Pearl Waltz for a group of children.
say:0:1721943001:1.source_cn: 你再次见到了阿德里安。这次，他正为孩子们演奏《珍珠圆舞曲》。
say:0:1721943001:1.male: Later, you see Aiden again. This time, he's playing Pearl Waltz for a group of children.
say:0:1721943001:1.female: Later, you see Aiden again. This time, he's playing Pearl Waltz for a group of children.

say:1:1721943002:0.text: And this time, he's smiling. Beside him, a graceful white cat is stretched out in the sun, looking perfectly pleased with herself.
say:1:1721943002:0.source_cn: 与之前不同的是，阿德里安的脸上露出了微笑，而一只高贵慵...

say:2:1721943003:1.text: The sight takes you by surprise. Somehow, while you were gone, Aiden and Lady Silvie seem to have grown a lot closer.
say:2:1721943003:1.source_cn: 这大大出乎了你的意料，在你不在的日子里，阿德里安和茜茜...
say:2:1721943003:1.male: The sight takes you by surprise. Somehow, while you were gone, Aiden and Lady Silvie seem to have grown a lot closer.
say:2:1721943003:1.female: The sight takes you by surprise. Somehow, while you were gone, Aiden and Lady Silvie seem to have grown a lot closer.

say:3:1721943004:1.text: Then the white cat spots you and gives you a cool, warning look, as if to tell you to keep that little secret to yourself.
say:3:1721943004:1.source_cn: 此时，那只白猫也注意到了你，眼神威严而略带威胁，似乎在...
say:3:1721943004:1.male: Then the white cat spots you and gives you a cool, warning look, as if to tell you to keep that little secret to yourself.
say:3:1721943004:1.female: Then the white cat spots you and gives you a cool, warning look, as if to tell you to keep that little secret to yourself.

say:4:1721943005:1.text: You take the hint. After listening through one full performance of Pearl Waltz, you quietly move on.
